w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — every fire has a theory tonight.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Peyton is calling it "Old Ugly." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Nora won't meet your eye. You said you'd help with the pantry run — and it never happened. Promises rot. (-15 trust)
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/11/7), with 7 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 13 · Craft 10 · Talk 14 · Explore 42 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE WITNESS — "Offer them a way back."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ines Duarte ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Domingo returns from the wilds hurt (health 6/100) — the trip cut short.
